title: Owner condition registry
description: Declares every ownerConditions id the card catalogue may reference, and how it is answered. Deliberately a SIDECAR rather than an inline object on EarnRule: card-catalogue.schema.json's ownerConditions is a published array of strings inside a content-addressed release with four vendored copies across two repos, and changing its element type would be a MAJOR catalogue bump for no behavioural gain. This mirrors programs.json, which solved the same open-set-modelled-as-closed problem for valuations. The engine still fails closed on an id it cannot resolve; this file is what lets a consumer ASK the question, which is the half that was missing when amazonEligiblePrimeLinked shipped unanswerable.

conditionsVersion.description: MAJOR.MINOR. Bump MINOR when adding a condition or a prompt; MAJOR only on a breaking shape change.

conditions.description: Keyed by the ownerConditions id used in card-catalogue.json earn rules.

answerKind.description: boolean answers are stored in CardState.flags keyed by this id, so a new yes/no condition needs no engine change. categorySelection is Tangerine's existing selection machinery (CardState.selectedCategories and friends), which stays structural because specific engine logic reads it rather than generic condition resolution — spec 3.2 draws that line.

prompt.description: English SOURCE string for the question. Required when answerKind is boolean. Consumers localize by id (ownerCondition.<id>.prompt) and fall back to this, so a new condition is askable the day it lands.

detail.description: English SOURCE string explaining what answering buys the owner. Shown beneath the question and in the wallet setup checklist.

maxSelections.description: categorySelection only: how many categories the issuer permits at once.
